nphi.title: DURABLE – large-scale emerging-disease project (EU4Health)
nphi.with: Institut Pasteur (coordinator); RIVM; ISS; INSA; Croatian Institute of Public Health; BIOR; Charité; FLI
nphi.summary: EU4Health project led by Institut Pasteur with national public health institutes across 15 countries on emerging disease preparedness.

nphi.title: QUANTUM – quality and utility labels for health data (EHDS)
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: Instituto Aragonés de Ciencias de la Salud (coordinator); 35 partner organisations
nphi.summary: Project developing quality and utility labels for health data for the European Health Data Space, with 35 organisations across 14 countries including Norway.

nphi.title: UNITED4Surveillance – integrated surveillance of infectious diseases
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: RIVM (coordinator/supporting organisation); NIPH Norway; partners in about 22-25 countries
nphi.summary: EU4Health Joint Action led by RIVM with over 40 partners, including Norway, building integrated and coordinated surveillance of infectious threats.

nphi.title: JADE Health – Joint Action addressing Dementia and Health
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.summary: EU Joint Action on dementia with 17 countries including Norway and Ukraine; Slovenian pilot on awareness and stigma reduction.

nphi.title: Before Time – protection against cervical cancer
nphi.with: Institute of Public Health of Montenegro; Health Centre Mostar; Health Centre Tivat; Public Health Institute Zadar (lead); Institute for the Perspective of Mediterranean Economy
nphi.summary: Interreg VI-A IPA project (about EUR 1.3m) expanding HPV vaccination, education and screening, with pilots of HPV self-sampling, across Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina and Montenegro.

nphi.title: EU-WISH – EU Wastewater Integrated Surveillance for Public Health
nphi.actor: National Institute of Public Health of Slovenia (NIJZ)
nphi.with: Norwegian Institute of Public Health; Statens Serum Institut (supporting organisation); partners from 26 countries
nphi.summary: EU4Health Joint Action with partners in 26 countries (incl. non-EU Norway and Ukraine) to strengthen wastewater-based surveillance of biological and chemical agents.

nphi.title: SECID – South East European Center for Surveillance and Control of Infectious Diseases
nphi.actor: SECID / Institute of Public Health, Albania (SEEHN)
nphi.with: South East European Center for Surveillance and Control of Infectious Diseases (Tirana); South-eastern Europe Health Network (SEEHN); national public health institutes of the region; CORDS network; assisted by US CDC
nphi.summary: Regional centre set up in Tirana in 2013 under SEEHN, linked to Albania's Institute of Public Health, that supports national authorities across South-East Europe on influenza and respiratory-pathogen surveillance, pandemic preparedness…

nphi.title: OH-EVI – Evidence-informed policy approaches for One Health
nphi.with: Croatian Institute of Public Health; KCCR/KNUST (Ghana); African Institute for Health Policy & Health Systems, David Umahi Federal University of Health Sciences (Nigeria); WHO
nphi.summary: Applied WHO EVIPNet to build multistakeholder teams for evidence-informed One Health policymaking.

nphi.title: ERI-Health – public health preparedness for cross-border epidemics and emergencies
nphi.actor: Public Health Institute of Republika Srpska
nphi.with: Institute of Public Health of Montenegro; Public Health Institute of Sisak-Moslavina County (Croatia)
nphi.summary: Interreg IPA cross-border project that upgraded outbreak diagnostics (COVID-19 PCR, zoonotic and vector-borne disease tests), trained health staff and set up quick information sharing between partners in the three countries.
